text:
Priya L.: Hi all — onboarding day 2, need a one-time Grafana edit to add an annotation for a canary release and enable the deploy-events datasource on the auth-service dashboard. Also need Datadog view for service-slos and Sentry project access for auth-service. Email priya.l@redwood.ai. Who should I ping?
Jules (DevEx): Welcome! :wave: For short tasks we prefer temporary roles. Please open an identity request with scope: grafana:annotation-editor (4h), datadog:standard, sentry:member and include the exact time window. Paste the request ID here and we can fast-track.
Priya L.: Okta shows observability-readers but no grafana:annotation-editor group. I filed request REQ-204001 with window 2024-06-05T14:00Z-2024-06-05T15:00Z.
infra-bot: Automated: Datadog invite queued for priya.l@redwood.ai (expires in 48h). Invite ref: 1825000000-INV. Track at https://idp.redwood/invites/1825000000
Maya (Eng): I can add the annotation for you if you don't want to request editor rights. Note: deploy-events datasource is write-protected; folder owners need to enable it.
Priya L.: I'd rather get the temporary editor to add alert notes and the annotation myself. REQ-204001 includes justification.
security-bot: Policy: EU access requires company-managed device + MFA. Confirm device compliance at https://idp.redwood/devices.
Priya L.: Device is pending approval, starting Okta Verify now.
Priya L.: Device approved.
Jules (DevEx): Fast-tracked and approved grafana:annotation-editor for the requested window, expires 2024-06-05T15:30Z. Sentry invite sent 44b.
Maya (Eng): Pushed folder permission for /team/auth to allow annotations. Verify with the API if you prefer:
```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $GRAF_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"dashboardUid":"service-auth","panelId":2,"time":"2024-06-05T14:05:00Z","text":"Canary release v1.3.0 - loadtest"}' https://grafana.internal/api/annotations
```
Priya L.: Tried it and annotation is visible on the dashboard. I can also see Sentry release-health and the Datadog SLOs now. Thanks everyone :tada:
Jules (DevEx): Nice. Reminder: the annotation-editor role will be auto-revoked at expiry. If you need a longer window update REQ-204001 with the reasons.
Priya L.: Will do if needed. Appreciate the quick help!
